test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **According.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to** means in the opinion of an individual or a group.

 
 
• **Example:** *Students always did everything according to the rules of the school. *
 
 
 
• So the word '**According**' fits in the blank no.1.

The correct sentence is:** Listening to Mozart can significantly increase your intelligence, according to research in America**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allowing** means permitting someone to do something or something to happen.
 
• **Awarding** means giving someone a prize, or payment as an award.
 
• **Acceding** means agreeing on a request or a demand.
